description: The utility SHALL read the current crontab using `popen("crontab -l","r")`. If `@reboot <caminho_binario>` does not exist in the current crontab, the utility SHALL add it using `popen("crontab -","w")`. The utility SHALL enumerate the target folders and delete files with the `.bak`, `.backup`, and `.old` extensions using `remove()`. The utility SHALL include a Makefile with an `all` target that compiles and a `clean` target that removes the binary and `.o` files.
name: crontab_file_cleanup_and_build
